quirks.name: Bites strangers
quirks.line: It snaps at anyone it doesn't know. It won't go to a new trainer until it trusts you deeply (Bond 4).

quirks.name: Hates rain
quirks.line: It sulks under every cloud. In rain it's slower (-1 Speed).

quirks.name: Loves rain
quirks.line: It dances in puddles. In rain it's quicker (+1 Speed).

quirks.name: Won't lead
quirks.line: It hangs back and lets the others go first. Given the choice, it would rather not be first out.

quirks.name: Always leads
quirks.line: It pushes to the front of every line. Given the choice, it would always be first out.

quirks.name: Steals Berries
quirks.line: Berries go missing from your bag. It looks very innocent about it.

quirks.name: Sings at night
quirks.line: It hums softly when the fire burns low. Everyone sleeps a little better.

quirks.name: Afraid of Balls
quirks.line: It flinches at the click of a Ball. It would rather walk beside you.

quirks.name: Show-off
quirks.line: It plays to a crowd. Its first move against a Gym Leader, Elite or Champion hits 10% harder.

quirks.name: Gentle
quirks.line: It never hits to hurt. It can't land a critical hit, and it grows fond of you faster.

quirks.name: Grudge
quirks.line: It remembers who wronged it. Its moves hit trainers' Pokémon 10% harder.

quirks.name: Collector
quirks.line: It picks up shiny things on the road and brings them to you, proud as anything.

quirks.name: Old
quirks.line: It has seen a lot of roads. It trusts easily, and grows fond of you faster than most.

quirks.name: Night owl
quirks.line: It wakes up when the sun goes down. Its moves are 5% more accurate at night, 5% less by day.
